name: harmonica-icons
notes: Two layers per icon, both currentColor: primary fill-opacity absent (=1), secondary fill-opacity="0.4".
Secondary never overlaps primary (same-color alpha stacking is invisible); it sits beside/under in negative space.
Boxes rx=3; line segments become filled capsules (rx=length/2); polygon vertices smoothed with quadratic cuts. Zero sharp 90-degree corners.
No strokes anywhere. No hex. No transforms.
